column1: # mmsimpulse base shortcuts.  name <TAB> keys <TAB> description <TAB> command
# Only keys that nothing else in this session answers. A shell's own keys live
# in its profile (`bind <keys>=<command>`, see profiles/dux). Without
# plasmashell the volume keys belong to a component that never starts, so they
# do nothing at all until something claims them. Each one is bound on install,
# unless something else already holds the key.

column4: sh -c 'command -v xdg-terminal-exec >/dev/null && exec xdg-terminal-exec || exec kitty -1'
